title: Seek Bar Overlay, Smooth VOD & Codec Fix, In-App Reboot & Subtitles
releaseNotes:
• Seek Bar HUD on Remote Scrubbing: Fast-forward and rewind remote controls immediately display a temporary 3-second seek bar with time stamps and scrub magnitude badge (+15s, -30s, etc.) without obscuring playback
• Clean In-App Reboot: Restored quick in-process app reboot recycling and activity restart, resolving launcher exit issue on modern Google TV and Android 12+
• Clean Startup Preview: App startup now displays a clean preview placeholder with 'Select a channel to start streaming' instead of spinning buffering indicators
• Google TV Audio Compatibility & VOD Stability: Fixed perpetual pause on Hulu/FX/Fox/ABC titles (such as 'The Drop: A Snowfall Saga') by decoding multi-channel audio directly to PCM and increasing buffer thresholds for smooth, uninterrupted playback
• Non-Intrusive Buffering HUD: Removed dark screen dimming and large center circles during buffering; video picture remains fully visible beneath a sleek corner indicator
• VOD Search Video Card Auto-Focus: Selecting a Movie or Series search result scrolls and directly focuses the target video card in its parent category
• Settings Simplification: Removed obsolete Smart Personalization option
• YouTube Closed Captions Fix: Added reactive settings state and fixed asynchronous captions module loading with English language preference in YouTube player
